turnaround_reason: MSP-focused software vendor (RMM + Cove backup + Adlumin cybersecurity) that lost more than half its value after a Q2 2026 print sent shares down 36% on weakening renewal rates and a cut full-year guide. The bull case is a cheap, 80%-gross-margin recurring-revenue business pivoting into faster-growing cyber resilience; the bear case is that the renewal deterioration is the start of a trend, not a blip.
bullish_points: High-quality model: ~80% gross margins, ARR ~$548M growing ~11%, FCF ~$70M - trades at ~0.9x book and ~8.9x forward P/E
Cybersecurity (Adlumin) is the fastest-growing segment (+17.5%) and now ~27% of revenue - genuine mix shift toward secular growth
Cove Data Protection (~38% of rev) also growing double digits; the pivot from commodity RMM has real legs
New-CEO/insider equity grants show alignment; net loss narrowed 91% YoY in Q1
bearish_points: Q2 2026 shares fell 36% on WEAKENING RENEWAL RATES + a guidance cut - the single most important datapoint and it's bad
Basing mode ~20% below the 200d MA; broken momentum, no confirmation the bottom is in
Core UEM (~35% of rev) growing only ~6% - the legacy base is decelerating and drags the blended rate
Debt/equity ~54% ($437M debt vs $116M cash); not distressed but not much room if ARR growth keeps slipping
yfinance news feed empty in the dossier; thesis relies on a single web pass, not deep channel checks
catalyst: Q3 FY2026 earnings on Nov 5, 2026 - the print that either confirms renewal-rate stabilization or extends the guide-down that broke the stock
suggested_trade: Spot only, small watch-list tranche. Wait for Q3 to show renewal rates stabilizing before adding - buying a broken-momentum SaaS name into an unconfirmed base after a 36% guide-down flush is catching the knife.
key_risk: The Q2 renewal-rate weakness is structural (MSP churn / competitive displacement), ARR growth keeps decelerating, and the 'cheap' multiple compresses further on a falling growth rate.
would_skip_if: Q3 shows renewal rates or net revenue retention deteriorating again - that invalidates the whole recurring-revenue thesis.
